keep.text: Maine ye galti saalon tak ki,
but aap log mat karna.
Ye sabzi dekh rahe ho?
Iska colour udd gaya hai, grey ho gayi hai,
aur gal bhi gayi hai.
Aur aaj ke time par ye sabzi khaane laayak nahi hai.
Harvard ke ek professor David Sinclair ne ye kaha tha ki if your vegetables start to lose colour,
you have gone to the unhealthy side.
Kyun kaha tha? Kyunki wo colour hi hai, jo chemical hai, jo aapko healthy rakh raha hai.
Usko kehte hain polyphenols.
Ab polyphenols kya hai?
Plant ka stress survival chemical hai.
Jab plant ko dhoop nahi milti hai
aur kam paani milta hai, toh
polyphenols
plant banata hai apne survival ke liye.
Aur jab hum ye plants khaate hain,
toh yahi polyphenols hamari body mein jaata hai,
aur ek SIRT1 enzyme ko activate karta hai. Anti-aging enzyme hai ye, jo DNA ko repair karta hai aur inflammation ko bhi kam karta hai.
Aur jab aap log overcook karte ho sabziyon ko, toh polyphenol destroy ho jaata hai. Colour gaya, yaani ki poori ki poori health gayi.
Aur suniye, Indian thaali duniya ki best anti-aging diet hai.
Haldi, palak, amla.
Amle ko vitamin C ka bomb ekdam kaha jaata hai. Achaar, kitne saare probiotics hain.
Daal plus khoob saari sabziyan jismein polyphenols hain.
Mediterranean diet hai jo
duniya ki healthiest diet maani jaati hai,
same composition hai, bas unke paas studies hain, hamare paas nahi thi.
Ek aur hack batata hoon: haldi plus ghee plus kaali mirch
curcumin absorption ko
2000% badha deta hai.
Aur ye hamare nana nani bahut pehle se karte aa rahe hain.
Science ne ab jaake prove kiya isko.
Mummy ke pairon mein psoriasis tha.
Bahut saare coloured plants unhone khaana shuru kiya, processed food ekdam zero kar diya, hum logon ne improvement dekha.
Same science jo aaj ke time par bahar Mediterranean diet kehlaayi jaa rahi hai, wo same science hum logon ne ghar par ki.
Polyphenols active hue, SIRT1 active hua, inflammation down hua, aur
kaun sa plant kitna khaana hai, kab khaana hai, kis cheez ke saath khaana hai, ye saari cheezein maine apne protocol mein bata rakhi hain. Toh agar aap logon ko bhi
mera health
protocol chahiye,
toh aap logon ko likhna padega comment box mein HP.
Toh aap logon ke paas link pahunch jaayega.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka hai. You are watching FitFinfluencer, milte hain next video mein!
